subject: Compute and Plot cdf on a geom_histogram()

messages.author: 334d5e0a5ee5bb44
messages.subject: Compute and Plot cdf on a geom_histogram()
parts: Is there an way to compute a cdf from a geom_histogram() and then plot that cdf on the histogram?

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Compute and Plot cdf on a geom_histogram()
parts:
Yes, but it's unlikely to be very useful because the scale of the
histogram and cdf will be rather different. If you'd like more help,
please provide a reproducible example:
https://github.com/hadley/devtools/wiki/Reproducibility

Hadley
